name: pyrosetta
description: Rosetta (ref2015) analysis of protein PDBs with PyRosetta 2026.34 on Aurora CPUs: total + per-term score (score), FastRelax refinement (relax), or binder/target interface metrics dG/dSASA/sc/packstat (interface). CPU-only; one row per PDB, returns scores JSON / relaxed PDB / interface JSON.
_gpus_note: PyRosetta is CPU-only and uses no GPU, but gpus=1 reserves one tile slot per row so EL packs 12 rows/node like the GPU skills. Tune upward if you want fewer concurrent CPU processes per node.
_timeout_note: 600s default. Measured: init ~11-20s cold / ~3s warm; score <1s; FastRelax 1 round ~4-33s depending on size; interface (packed) ~4-58s. Raise for many relax rounds or large complexes.
_expects_note: expects lists the 'score' deliverable (scores.json). action='relax' produces relaxed.pdb and action='interface' produces interface.json instead; the runner fails the row (exit 1) if its own action's expected output is missing. Set a per-action expects when staging if the executor enforces it strictly.
_doc: Per-skill MCP spec (docs/SKILL_MCP_DESIGN.md §5). CPU-only; subprocesses the committed, verified rosetta_tool.py under the pyrosetta_energy venv (one pyrosetta.init per process, via extra_options= so the -ex1/-ex2aro defaults are kept — the SKILL.md warns a positional init string silently changes packing/relax/interface results). score/relax/interface all VERIFIED on an Aurora debug node (2026-10-29). interface expects 2-chain partners (default 'A_B', target=A/binder=B); repacked interface dG carries ~1-3 REU stochastic noise (SKILL.md gotcha 1).
